paragraphs: R' Shimon ben Pazi. According to Zohar his father was called Pazi. See above, Yehudah ben Pazi and R' Yose ben Pazi: it appears that he was a priest. And R' Abba, R' Zeira, R' Hanina bar Pappi, R' Avahu, and R' Yitzhak Nappaha; see his entry. R' Avin said in R' Shimon ben Pazi's name; see above, R' Hoshaya bar Rabbi. Rav Dimi said in R' Shimon ben Pazi's name, who said in R' Yehoshua ben Levi's name. R' Yehudah was his son. He said in R' Yehoshua ben Levi's name: Yoma 69a; Avodah Zarah 35a. In R' Yehoshua ben Levi's name, who said in Bar Kappara's name: Berakhot 34a; Shabbat 40a, 105b, 118a; Mo'ed Katan 3b, and Ellu Megallehin in Bar Kappara's name; Sukkah 38b; Kiddushin 80a; Nedarim 87a; Pesahim 26a; Hullin 45, end of side a. R' Yitzhak bar Nahmani was with him. Mar Ukva frequented him. Ravin said in R' Shimon ben Pazi's name, in Bar Kappara's name: Zevahim 61b. Rav Shimi bar Ukva frequented him.
